# Generated copy: do not edit here

The skills in this folder are copied from `.agents/skills/`, which is the canonical location. Claude Code reads only
`.claude/skills/`, so the copy exists for it. Edit `.agents/skills/`, then run:

```
python scripts/sync_agent_skills.py
```

See `.agents/skills/README.md` for why there are two folders and why they are copies rather than symlinks.
